comparators: ordinary patient-mean PCA with identical patient CV folds
fixed low-harmonic Fourier subspaces at even dimensions
200 deterministic matched random mean-zero subspaces at selected dimension

cross_validation.dimension_rule: smallest d with CV R2_all >= max(0.90,0.95*R2_at_max_available_d) and CV R2_odd>=0.85 and CV R2_even>=0.85

forbidden_after_access: changing CV folds/seed or dimension rule
changing comparator family or random seeds
using clinical labels to redefine morphology axes

patient_representative.block_shape: normalize(mean accepted shape_norm beats within eligible 60-s block))
patient_representative.coherence: phase SD of unrenormalized block mean shape; retained separately
patient_representative.even_rep: normalize(mean even-indexed eligible block central shapes)
patient_representative.odd_rep: normalize(mean odd-indexed eligible block central shapes)

representation.beat_pipeline: authoritative WF1/WF2 native-125-Hz peak detection, midpoint boundaries, locked 30-min QC

within_window_alignment.interpretation: short-window precursor only; not WF3 long-duration covariance
metrics: within-window variance captured by between basis
positive between variance captured by within basis
within_window_alignment.within_operator: equal-patient mean covariance of eligible 60-s block central shapes about patient block mean
